findings.summary: .claude/commands/vfkb-new-project.md:90 claimed only .vfkb/entries.jsonl is committed, contradicting this repo's own governance (manifest.json is also committed, never gitignored) and failing the existing regression guard src/docs-committed-brain-files.test.ts (issue #220) — full suite was 551/552 red. Fixed in aee187b by correcting the line to name both files, matching the phrasing already used correctly elsewhere in the same diff (CONSUMER-ONBOARDING.md, CONSUMER-ONBOARDING-PROMPT.md). Full suite re-run green (552/552) after the fix.

ADR-0071's Consequences section cites vfkb-claude-plugin#50 / v0.14.0 as the companion hook-relocation PR; that PR lives in a sibling repo and its version/state is unverifiable from this repo alone (UNVERIFIED, informational). This PR's own fix (the consumer-settings template) does not depend on the sibling PR landing — the template simply omits the two broken hooks outright — so this does not block this merge. Left open rather than accepted: no operator sign-off was sought for this non-blocking item.

test/consumer-settings-template.test.ts pins the template to an exact key/hook set via toEqual rather than an allowlist, so any legitimate future addition to the template needs a same-PR test edit. Appears intentional given the docs' explicit "nothing else, ever" framing (ADR-0071) — noted as a design choice, not a defect; not blocking.
